data.description: Your Destination for Serenity, Opulence, and Sophistication

data.answer:
Al Waha in Dubailand offers a peaceful and quiet environment. This self-contained community provides many amenities, including a clubhouse, swimming pool, supermarket, park, playground, and scenic walkways.

The area is surrounded by lush green parks with palm trees, creating a serene and family-friendly atmosphere. Al Waha Villas Dubailand are ideal for those who want a tranquil lifestyle while enjoying easy access to Dubai's key locations, shopping centers, and other conveniences.

Al Waha is a tranquil villa sub-community within Dubai, featuring a mix of Mediterranean-style houses and a few apartments. This exclusive enclave also comprises villas surrounded by scenic walkways and green lawns, making it ideal for families.

These properties are known for their spacious interiors, modern amenities, and Mediterranean-style architecture, making them ideal choices for those settling in a secure and well-connected community.

Properties for Rent in Al Waha:

Looking for rental properties in Dubai? In Al Waha, rental options include a variety of villas suited for families. A 2-bedroom villa typically rents for around AED 125,000 per year. Most villas in Al Waha fall within a rental range of AED 40000 annually, providing a blend of affordability and luxury. Whether looking for a cozy 2-bedroom or larger family home, Al Waha offers quality living spaces in a peaceful, well-connected community.

Properties for Sale in Al Waha:

Buying a property in Al Waha offers excellent value for families and investors. Properties in Al Waha range from 2 to 5-bedroom villas, with 4-bedroom homes priced at AED 2M minimum. Larger families can find 5-bedroom villas for AED 2.85M. Apartments in Al Waha are also available, with prices starting as low as AED 1.0M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Waha?

data.answer:
Life in Al Waha, Dubai, is peaceful and family-friendly. It offers a mix of modern villas surrounded by lush green spaces. Residents enjoy a quiet community with nearby amenities like supermarkets, parks, and schools. The well-connected location provides easy access to shopping, dining, and recreational options, making it a perfect place for comfortable living.

Public Transportation Al Waha

Al Waha mainly relies on bus services, with nearby stops at The Sustainable City and Arabian Ranches 2. For those who drive, the area provides easy access to Emirates Road and ample parking within the community’s properties.

Residents can also easily access the metro service. The Mall of the Emirates Metro Station is the nearest metro station to Al Waha in Dubai. This station is on the Red Line of the Dubai Metro and is a short drive away from Al Waha, making it a convenient option for residents to access the metro network.

Supermarkets in Al Waha

Residents of the Al Waha Building can shop at Bluemart Minimart within the community. Nearby options for convenient grocery shopping include Choithrams in Layan, Zoom in The Sustainable City, and Carrefour Market at Ranches Souk, all just a short drive away.

Shopping Malls Near Al Waha

Mudon Community Centre and The Ranches Souk are nearby shopping destinations. For more options, visit My City Centre Al Barsha or Dubai Outlet Mall, a 14- to 18-minute drive away and offering diverse retail and dining experiences.

Schools Near Al Waha

Families in Al Waha can access several schools in nearby communities, such as Arabian Ranches and The Sustainable City. These schools offer a range of educational programs to suit different needs, making it easy for families to find suitable options for their children.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Al Waha

Al Waha’s nearby mosques include Al Madina Al Mustadama Masjid and Mudon Mosque. For other places of worship, residents can visit churches and temples in Al Barsha and Jebel Ali, within a 20 to 30-minute drive from Al Waha.

Clinics and Hospitals in Al Waha

Al Waha has several healthcare facilities, including Aster Clinic in Arabian Ranches 2 and The Chiron Clinic in The Sustainable City. Nearby hospitals like Mediclinic Parkview and NMC Royal Hospital offer comprehensive medical services for residents.

Al Waha Location & Nearby Areas

Al Waha is situated near Arabian Ranches 2 and The Sustainable City. Although it’s slightly away from central Dubai, it provides easy access to areas such as Jebel Ali, Remraam, and Dubai Investments Park, making it a well-connected location.

more_info.question: Things to Do In Al Waha

data.answer:
In Al Waha, residents enjoy a peaceful lifestyle with nearby recreational options. Visit the local parks and green spaces for relaxation. For dining, head to restaurants in nearby communities. Shop for essentials at the local supermarkets. Enjoy easy access to schools and clinics for added convenience.

Restaurants In and Near Al Waha 

While Al Waha itself has no restaurants, nearby dining options include Tuk Tuk Thai Cuisine and Maria Bonita Taco Shop & Grill in The Sustainable City and Chez Sushi and Carluccio’s in The Ranches Souk. These spots offer diverse cuisines and are just a short drive away.

Beaches Near Al Waha 

Though Al Waha is inland, several beautiful beaches are within a 25-minute drive. Jumeirah Beach offers family-friendly fun, while JBR Beach, Sunset Beach, Kite Beach, and Al Sufouh Beach provide various activities and scenic views for a relaxing day.

Hotels in Al Waha

In Al Waha, you can stay at the Radisson Hotel and Vintage Grand Hotel. Both options offer comfortable accommodations and convenient access to local attractions and amenities. These hotels ensure a pleasant stay close to the peaceful surroundings of Al Waha.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Al Waha  

Residents of Al Waha enjoy nearby attractions like IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village, both 11 minutes away. For outdoor enthusiasts, the Al Qudra Desert and the Al Qudra Cycle Track offer adventure and scenic beauty. Arabian Ranches Golf Club and Al Habtoor Polo Resort are also nearby.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Al Waha offers a serene environment with lush green lawns and scenic walkways, perfect for strolls or family outings. Kids can enjoy the community playgrounds and parks, while adults can access wellness activities at Al Waha Clubhouse. For more fitness options, Fitness First in Arabian Ranches 2 is just 7 minutes away, and The Haven Spa in Layan is only 4 minutes away for relaxation and beauty treatments.

Al Waha is a well-developed community known for its spacious villas, which are more affordable than central Dubai. However, its location on the outskirts of New Dubai might make it feel a bit remote from other key areas. Public transportation options are few, with bus stops some distance away. As the community continues to grow and develop, these aspects are improving and making it more convenient for residents.

What Is Al Waha Dubai Known For? 

Al Waha Dubai is renowned for its tranquil, gated community with spacious Mediterranean-style villas, lush green spaces, and proximity to crucial Dubai landmarks. It offers a range of rental and freehold options, making it ideal for families seeking a peaceful lifestyle.

What Schools Are Near Al Waha? 

 While Al Waha does not have schools within the community, several educational institutions are located in nearby areas, such as Arabian Ranches and The Sustainable City, offering various programs for children of all ages.

How far is Global Village from Al Waha?

Global Village is just 10 minutes away from the area.

Are There Any Restaurants In Al Waha?  

Al Waha does not have restaurants within the community. Still, nearby options include Tuk Tuk Thai Cuisine Maria Bonita Taco Shop & Grill in The Sustainable City and Chez Sushi and Carluccio’s in The Ranches Souk.

How Can I Find Al Waha Villas For Rent?

data.content:
Al Waha Dubai is a modern, gated villa community within Dubailand that was developed by Dubai Properties. It offers exclusive villas for sale and rent, making it a popular choice for individuals and families.

The Al Waha area is well-known for its theme parks, tourist spots, shopping malls, waterfront restaurants, and resorts. Its one—to four-bedroom units offer reasonable rental and freehold options.

It is located along Emirates Road (E611) and offers easy access to Dubai Investments Park, Al Maktoum International Airport, and the Expo 2020 site.
